name: ink cloud
desc:
Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes damage while underwater.
Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} releases ink that fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=1MiIPcVuCpfgBIkS]]-foot Cube centered on itself, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
